answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 5 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the pearl reference is updated at each mesa checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the forge audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 70 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
